data_issues: The unit (neuron) columns of test_unlabeled.npz are permuted relative to train/val: per-unit mean firing rates in test do not line up with train/val, but they match one-to-one after reordering. I recovered the permutation by Hungarian matching on per-unit firing statistics (test column order mapping: [17, 23, 11, 24, 13, 0, 6, 9, 25, 12, 3, 7, 1, 15, 16, 19, 18, 22, 2, 20, 10, 14, 21, 4, 5, 8, 26]) and applied it before decoding. Train/val labels agree exactly with image_id, classes are balanced (24/7 per class), and there are no other anomalies.
